Commercial Air Duct Installation for San Diego Businesses

Need new ductwork for your building? Sky Clean Air plans and installs commercial air ducts that help keep your people comfortable, your equipment running right, and your energy bills in check. We serve offices, warehouses, retail, schools, restaurants, healthcare, fitness centers, and more across San Diego County.

If you are looking for Commercial Air Duct Installation in San Diego, our local team is ready to help. Call {{phone}} or visit skycleanair.com to schedule a site visit. You can also reach our team through our Contact Us page.

Why Proper Ductwork Matters

Air ducts are the lungs of your HVAC system. If the duct design is poor or the ducts leak, your building pays the price. Here is what goes wrong with the wrong duct setup

  • Hot and cold spots that never settle down
  • Stuffy rooms and stale odors
  • High power bills because the system is fighting leaks
  • Noise from vibration or undersized ducts
  • Dust settling on every surface
  • Moisture problems that can lead to corrosion or mold concerns
  • Added wear on HVAC equipment because of high static pressure

Now picture the opposite. Clean and quiet airflow. Thermostats that match real room temperatures. Balanced air to every zone with help from proper duct balancing. Lower fan speeds without losing comfort. That is what a well planned commercial duct system can deliver.

Ready for a building that feels right? Let us talk about what you need and what we build for you. For a full checkup you can also schedule a duct testing or duct leakage test.

Why Sky Clean Air Is a Smart Choice in San Diego

We live and work in San Diego. That means we understand how local weather and building types affect airflow and duct materials.

  • Coastal salt air can attack thin or unprotected metals
  • Santa Ana winds can push dust and fine ash into intake points
  • Morning marine layers add moisture to outdoor air
  • Many downtown buildings have tight shaft space and strict noise limits
  • Industrial parks in Otay Mesa, Miramar, and Kearny Mesa need high air changes and large trunk lines
  • Biotech and lab spaces in Sorrento Valley and Torrey Pines need careful pressure control and clean air

We plan around your site, your schedule, and the way your team uses the building. Need work done overnight or on weekends so operations stay on track? We do that. Need cranes set for rooftop equipment in the Gaslamp or UTC with street permits and safety plans? We handle it.

We are licensed and insured. Our crews keep a clean jobsite, protect your finishes, and communicate clearly so you always know what is next.

Our Step by Step Process

Clear process. On time work. No surprises. Here is how we approach each project.

Step 1 Site Walk and Airflow Review

We start with a walkthrough of your space. We check the following so the plan matches your building and goals.

  • Existing HVAC units and capacities
  • Supply and return locations
  • Ceiling heights and obstructions
  • Room uses and occupancy
  • Access for lifts, ladders, and cranes
  • Noise limits and odor control needs
  • Build timeline and phasing with your other trades

Do you already have mechanical plans? We will build to your drawings. Need help planning the duct layout? We can produce a practical design based on your equipment and local code. For existing systems we can perform a ductwork inspection or a commercial HVAC inspection.

Step 2 Load and Layout Planning

We size the main trunks and branches for even airflow and proper static pressure. We place supply diffusers and returns to reduce drafts and dead zones. We plan zones to match the way you use the space. Conference room with 10 people but used only a few hours a day? We size and control it to serve that reality. Where helpful we design with commercial HVAC zoning in mind.

We also plan for future changes. If you think another suite will be added next year, we leave capacity and access points where it makes sense.

Step 3 Material Selection

Different buildings need different duct types. We use the following based on your needs.

  • Galvanized steel for strength and long life
  • Double wall insulated duct where sound control is important
  • Spiral duct for open ceilings with an architectural look
  • Lined duct to reduce fan noise and vibration
  • Phenolic or fiberglass duct in certain light duty cases
  • Kitchen and lab connections with grease or specialty requirements

San Diego coastal air can be rough on thin metal. In areas close to the ocean like Pacific Beach or Point Loma, we may suggest heavier gauge steel, added coating, or specific insulation to protect key sections.

Step 4 Fabrication and Installation

We fabricate duct sections to fit your layout and existing structure. During install we focus on protection and coordination.

  • Protect floors, furniture, and inventory
  • Coordinate lifts and crane days for rooftop work
  • Keep aisles clear to maintain access for your team
  • Install hangers and supports to code and to match your ceiling type
  • Label ducts and zones
  • Install access doors for cleaning and inspection

We phase the work so your business stays open whenever possible. If you need quiet hours for meetings or classes, we make it happen. For projects with new rooftop equipment we coordinate with your commercial rooftop unit scheduling.

Step 5 Sealing Insulation and Controls

Leaky ducts cost you money. We seal all joints and seams using proven methods similar to our duct sealing service. We insulate ducts in unconditioned spaces to cut loss and prevent condensation. We also set manual or motorized dampers so each zone gets the right airflow. If controls are part of your plan we can assist with commercial HVAC control setup and commercial thermostat installation.

If your system has CO2 sensors, economizers, or demand control ventilation, we coordinate with your controls vendor to make sure readings and damper actions line up with the new duct layout.

Step 6 Testing Balancing and Commissioning

Before we call it done, we test the system thoroughly. This includes air duct testing and final air balancing.

  • Measure supply and return airflows at each register
  • Check static pressure across the system
  • Adjust dampers and diffusers to hit target flows
  • Verify temperature splits and noise levels
  • Confirm control sequences with your HVAC units

We give you final readings and mark damper positions so your facility team can keep things dialed in. If needed we can document duct leakage testing as part of closeout.

Systems We Work With

We install ductwork for many commercial HVAC setups, including the following.

  • Rooftop packaged units serving open office or retail
  • Split systems for small suites and tenant buildouts
  • VRF systems with branch boxes and multiple indoor units
  • Make up air and exhaust for kitchens and production spaces
  • Dedicated outside air systems for schools and healthcare with proper airflow balancing
  • Filtration upgrades for studios, gyms, and clinics with options like media filters
  • Warehouse ventilation with large supply and high volume exhaust

Have a mixed use building with offices up front and warehouse in back? We can zone both areas and balance temperatures without overworking the equipment.

Signs You Need New Ducts

Wondering if duct replacement is worth it? These signs point to yes.

  • Rooms never hit setpoint no matter how low you set the thermostat
  • You smell odors between suites or from the warehouse
  • Dust builds up fast after cleaning
  • You see rust, gaps, torn insulation, or oil stains near duct joints
  • Fans are loud and run hard to keep up
  • Your energy bills climbed after a layout change or tenant improvement
  • Moisture or dripping near supply registers
  • New code or use change needs more outside air than your ducts can handle

If you are dealing with any of these, ask us to evaluate. We can tell you what must be replaced, what can be repaired, and what changes will deliver the biggest benefit. We handle both commercial duct replacement and targeted duct repairs.

Energy Efficiency and Comfort Gains

A smart duct layout pays off month after month. Here is where the savings and comfort come from.

  • Right sized trunks and branches reduce static pressure so fans work less
  • Proper sealing cuts leakage that wastes cooled or heated air
  • Short and direct runs lower resistance and noise
  • Good return air paths reduce pressure imbalances and door whistling
  • Insulation controls heat gain in hot plenum spaces
  • Correct diffuser selection reduces drafts in open offices
  • Economizer and outside air paths are clear and measured which helps ventilation without wasting energy

Do your staff fight over the thermostat? Balanced air and correct diffuser placement help keep everyone comfortable from corner office to copy room. If needed we can add zoning for better control.

Special Needs by Facility Type

Every space has its own airflow needs. We install ductwork that matches your use.

Offices and Coworking

  • Quiet supply for open desks and private offices
  • Strong return paths to avoid temperature swings
  • Zoning for meeting rooms that fill up fast
  • Filtration that keeps dust and odors down

Retail and Restaurants

  • Even temperatures at entrances and display areas
  • Vestibule air curtains and diffusers that cut drafts
  • Make up air for kitchens so odors do not creep into dining areas
  • Hidden duct options for clean ceilings in retail displays

Warehouses and Light Industrial

  • Large trunk lines and high throw diffusers for tall spaces
  • Extra outside air to handle forklifts or light process loads
  • Spot cooling for packing stations and loading docks
  • Durable materials that handle dust and frequent use

Healthcare and Clinics

  • Clean supply and return routing to reduce cross contamination risks
  • Pressure control for procedure rooms and labs
  • Filtration upgrades with minimal noise

Schools and Fitness

  • High ventilation rates with quiet operation
  • Return air designs that handle large swings in occupancy
  • Filtration that holds up to high traffic

Biotech and Labs

  • Specific air changes for lab zones
  • Exhaust routing for hoods and enclosures
  • Pressure relationships between clean and support areas

Local Scenarios Across San Diego

We build for real San Diego situations.

  • Downtown office retrofit near the Gaslamp where we scheduled crane picks early morning and kept noise low during business hours
  • Sorrento Valley lab expansion that needed new outside air duct runs and pressure control for clean spaces
  • Miramar brewery install with large make up air and filtered supply to keep the production floor comfortable
  • Otay Mesa warehouse with 30 foot ceilings, high volume diffusers, and big returns that kept fan speeds down
  • Point Loma retail building with coastal exposure where we used heavier gauge duct and extra coating to fight salt air

Got a project in La Jolla, Chula Vista, Kearny Mesa, or North County? We are already in your area most weeks.

Working Around Your Schedule

We plan around your day. Office open 9 to 5. We can demo and hang mains after hours. Warehouse shipping windows from 6 to 10 am. We shift lifts and staging to avoid blocking docks. Schools need quiet during testing. We schedule noisy tasks for off days.

We coordinate with your GC and other trades to keep projects moving. We stage materials to avoid clutter and keep exits clear.

Safety and Cleanliness

Safety matters for your staff and our team. We follow site safety plans, use fall protection at heights, and keep walkways open. We run negative air during demo when needed to keep dust under control. We lay down floor protection and clean up each day so your space is usable.

Materials and Build Quality

We use strong and code compliant materials that fit the job.

  • Galvanized steel in the right gauge for your spans
  • Spiral or rectangular duct depending on ceiling space and look
  • Internal lining where sound control is needed
  • Double wall where insulation and sound control both matter
  • Proper hangers, strut, and seismic bracing where required
  • Mastic and tape that hold up in real world conditions

Ducts are built to last. We make sure access doors are in smart places so future cleaning and filter checks do not turn into a wrestling match in the ceiling. Ask about ongoing ductwork inspections if you want periodic reviews.

Ventilation and Air Quality

Fresh air is just as important as temperature. We help you get the right amount of ventilation for the space use. That can include the following.

  • Outside air ducts and mixing sections sized for your occupancy
  • CO2 based control to cut energy use when spaces are empty
  • Filtration upgrades that match your fan capacity
  • Return paths that prevent stagnant zones

Want to cut odors in a gym or keep conference rooms from feeling stuffy? Ask about small changes that make a clear difference. For added cleanliness we can coordinate with commercial HVAC air duct disinfecting when appropriate.

Replacement vs Repair

Not sure if you need a full replacement? In many cases we can reuse good sections and replace only the problem areas. We will show you where leaks or bottlenecks live and what repairs can do. If your ductwork is undersized or failing across multiple zones, a full replacement can pay back through energy savings and fewer comfort complaints. Learn more about replacement options and targeted repairs.

We will never push more work than you need. You will see exactly what we plan to install and why.

Timeline and What To Expect

Install times vary by building size and access, but here is a basic path.

  • Site visit and plan review
  • Proposal with scope, materials, and schedule
  • Permit and plan check if required
  • Fabrication of duct sections
  • Demo of old duct and prep
  • Hanging mains and branches
  • Sealing, insulation, and labeling
  • Startup, testing, and balancing
  • Final walkthrough and handoff

Typical small tenant improvement may take a few days to a week. Mid size office floors or warehouse zones can take multiple weeks, especially with phasing. Have a deadline tied to a move in date? Tell us early so we can structure the schedule and crew size to hit it.

Clear Pricing

We quote based on duct length, material type, number of zones, ceiling height, access, and controls. Permits, crane days, and after hours work also affect cost. You get a written scope so you can see everything included. Need value options to meet a budget? We can suggest material or routing choices that save money without hurting performance.

After Install Care

Good ductwork stays good with basic care. We recommend the following.

  • Filter changes on schedule for your units
  • Periodic duct inspections through access doors
  • Balancing checks after major layout changes
  • Cleaning if you see dust buildup or after certain renovations
  • Keeping supply and return paths clear of storage or partitions

We also offer commercial air duct cleaning and ongoing commercial air duct maintenance if you want one team for both install and upkeep.

Common Challenges We Solve

  • Tight ceilings with lots of other utilities. We route clean and short runs that still allow access to lights, sprinklers, and cable trays
  • Noisy open offices. We use lined duct, quieter diffusers, and smart return placement with final air balancing
  • Hot warehouses. We plan high throw diffusers and larger return grilles to move heat off the ceiling plane
  • Restaurants with odor issues. We improve make up air and balance exhaust so smells do not drift into dining spaces
  • Older buildings with odd geometry. We custom fabricate transitions that fit without killing airflow

Got a challenge that makes other contractors shrug? Tell us what is going on. We love solving real world space puzzles.

Commercial Air Duct Installation for New Builds and Retrofits

Whether you are building new in Mission Valley or refreshing a 1970s office in Kearny Mesa, our team brings practical solutions that fit your use and code. We coordinate with your architect and mechanical engineer on new builds, and we help GCs and owners on fast track tenant improvements. If the project includes new equipment we can coordinate with commercial HVAC installation or commercial AC installation as needed.

This is true for small suites and large campuses. We scale crews to match your schedule and keep communication tight so other trades can plan around us.

Local Code and Inspections

We install to local and state codes and handle the details that inspectors look for. That includes proper clearances, fire smoke damper integration where required, correct insulation, and labeling. We meet your inspector on site and address any comments fast to keep your project moving. Learn more about components like fire dampers if your design calls for them.
